Main paper computational details: geometry optimizations at ωB97X-D/def2-TZVPP.
Main paper computational details: vibrational analyses confirmed minimum structures.
Main paper computational details: TD-DFT on optimized S0 geometries with 50 excited states.
Main paper computational details: singlets use implicit CH2Cl2 SMD; triplets are gas phase.
